author: Jay
name: PZAdmin
short: Project Zomboid server status, restarts and mod requests via PZAdmin.
description: Shows Project Zomboid server status and who is online, lets approved users trigger a graceful restart, and lets players request mods for the server tied to the channel they're in. The bot only talks to PZAdmin's HTTP API; PZAdmin does the RCON, container and mod work itself.
install_msg: Set up with [p]pzadminset url <pzadmin url> (e.g. http://192.168.0.50:27815), then DM the bot: [p]set api pzadmin api_key <key>. Check it with [p]pzadminset show. For slash commands: [p]slash enable pz, [p]slash enable pzctl, then [p]slash sync. The key needs the control scope for restarts. Lock down restarts with [p]permissions setdefaultglobalrule deny pzctl, then allow specific users with [p]permissions addglobalrule allow pzctl <user>. For mod requests: give the key the request scope, link each server's channel with [p]pzadminset link #channel <server>, then [p]slash sync again so /pz request shows up. Requests wait in the Requests section of the server's Mods tab in PZAdmin.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores which channels belong to which server. Mod requests send the requester's Discord username and ID to your PZAdmin, which keeps them with the request.
